infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bloom uses your camera to let you add a profile photo and scan documents for your birth plan.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Bloom accesses your photo library so you can choose a profile picture or add photos to your pregnancy journal.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Bloom saves photos to your library when you export your birth plan or pregnancy summary.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Bloom reads health data such as weight and heart rate to enrich your pregnancy tracking.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Bloom writes pregnancy milestones and weight logs to Apple Health so all your health data stays in sync.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Bloom uses Face ID to keep your pregnancy data private and secure.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Bloom uses your location to find nearby hospitals and healthcare providers. You can use Bloom without granting location access.
